ocrProcessingStep.processingStepDescription: Unreviewed line-level HTR: one String per complete segment; its box describes the segment, not an individual word. Same physical line IDs. CATMuS uses Kraken polygon/baseline extraction; Medusa uses padded rectangular crops with its internal image resizing. Not a controlled accuracy benchmark.
